name: Pavel Hartmann
headline: Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend Engineer with a strong focus on building and improving user interfaces across product teams. Experienced in delivering reliable features, refining interaction quality, and collaborating closely with design and product partners. Background also includes finance operations work with careful reporting, reconciliation, and process discipline.
